name: Sunplus Innovation Technology Inc.
summary: Sunplus Innovation Technology Inc. researches, develops, manufactures, and markets microcontrollers and system-on-chips with embedded software solutions in Taiwan, China, and internationally. It provides wired optical mice, wireless desktops, and MCU for HID and toy devices; and Web, NB, and IOT camera controllers. The company's products are used in human interface devices, PC external HDD/ODD drives, and PC/NB camera and industry control market segments. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
